subject: Hybrid engagement stack licensing + migration SOW for Q3 rollout
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid engagement stack licensing + migration SOW for Q3 rollout

Team —

Quick summary: Northbridge is asking for a recommendation and cost estimate to move their sellers to a hybrid engagement stack for Q3. They currently run Outreach for sequence orchestration and a small Salesloft pilot. Their procurement lead (cc'd in vendor threads) prefers minimizing change to seller workflows but wants better reporting and playbook centralization.

Options on the table:
- Consolidate everything onto Outreach (lower integration work, vendor discount required)
- Consolidate onto Salesloft (Salesloft claims better reporting for our use case)
- Hybrid approach: Outreach for high-volume sequences + Salesloft pilot for enterprise AE team, plus a migration & adoption SOW from a consultancy (SignalLoop) to standardize playbooks and data flows.

From our side I think the hybrid option reduces risk and lets us negotiate a combined commercial package: smaller Outreach seat reduction, salesloft pilot credits, and a SOW for migration & training. We should also capture procurement ask items: PO timing, SOC2 evidence, data retention, and training timeline.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you run the seat delta and ARR impact for all three options by EOD Thu? (Include true-up scenarios)
- Priyom: loop in procurement and get a template PO window and legal redline timeline.
- Karthik: reach out to SignalLoop for an initial SOW draft and cost for a 4-week migration + 2-week training block.

I will open a vendor thread to get preliminary pricing; we need to have a recommended commercial plan to present to Northbridge on Monday (4/17).

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0193
From: Alexa Moore <alexa@signalloop.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@outreach.io>, Kevin Owen <kevin.owen@salesloft.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid engagement stack licensing + migration SOW for Q3 rollout

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the context. SignalLoop can produce a short SOW scoped for two parallel streams: (1) Sequence migration & mapping (3 weeks) focused on Outreach -> Outreach consolidation and Salesloft pilot configuration, (2) Adoption & training (2 weeks) for AEs and SDRs, plus playbook documentation and a dashboard handoff.

High level pricing (ballpark until we see seat counts):
- Migration & mapping: $28,000
- Adoption & training: $12,000
- Post-launch 30-day hypercare: $6,000
- Total: $46,000 (+ travel if onsite)

Deliverables:
- Migration plan and mapping doc (CSV of sequences and playbooks)
- Training decks and recorded sessions
- Technical runbook for reporting and CRM syncs

We can attach a draft SOW and a sample playbook. I attached SignalLoop_SOW_v1.pdf and the pricing comparison sheet. I can also set up a 30-min scoping call with both vendors tomorrow.

Questions for us:
- Does Northbridge need SignalLoop to sign an NDA or go through a security questionnaire?
- Any preferred milestone/payment schedule?

If you want us to fast-track a signed SOW to meet a 4/17 presentation, we'll need a go/no-go by 4/13 COB.

Best,
Alexa Moore
Principal Consultant | SignalLoop Consulting
alexa@signalloop.com
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@outreach.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alexa Moore <alexa@signalloop.com>
Cc: Kevin Owen <kevin.owen@salesloft.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid engagement stack licensing + migration SOW for Q3 rollout

Ben / Alexa —

Appreciate the clear scope. A couple of notes from Outreach: we can offer a blended commercial that gives a 15% discount on net-new seats when the purchase includes a services SOW of at least $40k. Outreach is comfortable with a hybrid deployment (Outreach primary, limited Salesloft pilot) — we will provide the CRM sync guide and a dedicated implementation manager for the migration window.

On security: we have a SOC2 report and a standard security appendix (attached: security-appendix-redwood.pdf). We can provide references and a short architecture diagram for the sync.

If SignalLoop signs a subconsent to our data handling addendum we can expedite kickoff. I'll also send a short pricing comparison sheet for Outreach vs Salesloft for the proposed seat counts.

—Lisa Chen
Enterprise Sales, Outreach
lisa.chen@outreach.io
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Moore <alexa@signalloop.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kevin Owen <kevin.owen@salesloft.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid engagement stack licensing + migration SOW for Q3 rollout

Thanks everyone — quick next steps so I can present a clean recommendation to Northbridge on Monday: 

1) SignalLoop: please send the updated SOW with milestone-based payments and a line item for travel if needed by EOD Sun (4/14). Attach the final SOW and we will include in procurement packet.
2) Outreach: please send the formal pricing for the blended commercial and the delivery manager name so procurement can create the PO.
3) Marissa / Priyom: attach the seat delta revenue scenarios and procurement timing. We need a target PO date from Northbridge (they previously indicated PO by 4/27 is acceptable).
4) Kevin: if Salesloft wants to propose a counter to the hybrid model (full consolidation), please submit a brief one-pager that calls out reporting advantages and any migration credits by COB Mon (4/16).

I attached the pricing comparison and the draft SOW from SignalLoop in the thread for easy reference. If we can get all of these by EOD Mon we can finalize terms and push the procurement packet Monday afternoon.

—Ben
